caption: The drawing consists of eight rectangular sections arranged in two rows with various abstract and geometric shapes rendered in a black-and-white color scheme. The background is black, and the objects are in white, creating a high-contrast appearance. In the upper left section, there is a circular shape, a zigzag line, and an animal with four legs and a pointed nose, resembling a dog. The next section to the right features a tall, slender human-like figure with extended arms and legs. The third section contains a small, rounded figure with both arms raised. The fourth section in the top row shows a larger four-legged animal with a person or similar figure sitting on its back. The bottom row, from left to right, begins with a rectangular section containing two human-like figures, one tall and wavy, the other shorter, both with outstretched arms and rounded heads. The next section shows a round-headed figure standing on two legs with its arms raised, with a small circle above its head. The next section shows an abstract creature with a large head, spread-fingered hands, and three legs. The far right section in the bottom row contains a circular, wheel-like shape with spokes, and a small human-like figure with spiky hair holding a ring or circle. All objects are depicted using bold, simplified forms without internal detail.
title: Petroglyph Design
